items.title: YES Bank Q4 biz update: Loans rise 11%, deposits grow 12% YoY
items.description: YES Bank reported steady Q4 growth, with advances rising 6% QoQ and deposits outpacing at 9%, improving its CD ratio to 85.4%. Strong CASA traction supported margins, though reliance on certificates of deposit increased. Liquidity remained comfortable. Overall, improving deposit quality and a stronger liability franchise signal a more balanced outlook despite measured loan growth.
